verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (/reference/... pages for monitoring, exports, audit, transactions and identity). It also offers an official Postman collection for runnable requests and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, which probing confirmed is publicly retrievable. The evidence never shows the reference itself being interactive, so runnable examples come through the separate Postman collection. Missing for 10: documented in-browser 'try it' console in the reference, embedded runnable code samples per endpoint, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
